lyrics:
[Intro]
Five years together, look how far we’ve come,
Dancing under city lights, still burning strong.

[Verse 1]
You’re my rhythm when the night feels slow,
Every heartbeat’s got your glow.
When you smile, the world feels right,
You’re the reason stars shine bright.

[Chorus]
Angela, you’re my melody,
My forever, endlessly.
Dancing close, just you and me,
In this love, we’re wild and free.

[Verse 2]
Every sunrise, every sigh,
You’re the fire that lights my sky.
When you move, the world slows down,
Queen of my heart, my golden crown.

[Bridge]
Let’s keep the beat until the morning,
Love so strong, it keeps on calling.
Five years down and forever to go,
Angela, I’ll never let you go.

[Outro]
Every rhythm, every tune,
Still in love beneath the moon.
You’re my song, my light, my soul,
Together we make the music whole.
